notes: Nothing changes on screen in this build. Under the hood, a running job now reports how long it has been since its progress last moved, and the point at which Crisp gives up waiting — so a render that is stuck can be told apart from one that is merely slow. Crisp has had a bar sit frozen at 77% while nothing was happening, and until now nothing in the app could tell the difference. The progress bar does not use these yet; that is the next change, and this one is the groundwork. Nothing got slower.
